item.title: Find your ‘Lucky Match’ at Power Mac Center
item.description: Celebrate the Year of the Fire Horse and Valentine’s Day with exclusive offersTwo celebrations centered on connection arrive almost side by side: one ingrained in personal affection, the other in family and tradition.This February, premier Apple partner Power Mac Center (PMC) embraces its role as a supporter of shared moments and the Filipinos’ partner in thoughtful gift-giving. Whether you’re looking for a “Lucky Match” in love or in life, PMC offers meaningful ways to celebrate the season.

item.title: Valentine’s Weekend Treat: Beef Pares for ₱30 at IKEA!
item.description: Valentine’s weekend just got sweeter—and tastier! Forget the flowers, because the only ka‑“pares” you’ll need is waiting at IKEA Pasay City.

item.title: Serta’s Road to the World’s Best Mattress Caravan Arrives in the Philippines
item.description: Serta’s Road to the World’s Best Mattress Hits the Philippines Ever wondered what it feels like to sleep like you’re in a five‑star hotel—without checking into one? Serta’s got you covered. Their Road to the World’s Best Mattress caravan is rolling through malls across the country, giving Filipinos the chance to test‑drive (or should we say test‑nap?) their famous mattresses.

item.title: Star City Chinese New Year 2026 Promo – ₱200 OFF Admission
item.description: KUNG HEI FAT CHOI! 🧧🐎Celebrate Chinese New Year 2026 at Star City with a special treat! Enjoy ₱200 OFF on admission tickets by simply presenting a screenshot or printed coupon of the poster above. With extended hours on weekends and festive attractions for all ages, Star City is the perfect destination to welcome the Year of the Horse with joy, prosperity, and fun.

item.title: UNLI Yang Chow ₱168 at Super Bowl of China
item.description: ₱168 for UNLI Yang Chow? Believe it! 😱Craving rice? Super Bowl of China brings back the unbeatable UNLI Yang Chow promo this February 16–20, 2026! For only ₱168, enjoy unlimited servings of Yang Chow rice at select branches nationwide. Strictly no sharing — so bring your appetite and savor every bite!

item.title: Lucky Sips at Chatime: Buy 1 Take 1 Lunar New Year Treat
item.description: Lucky Sips Await This Lunar New Year!Ring in the season of fortune with Chatime’s BUY 1 TAKE 1 treat! 🧋 Yes! Enjoy a festive Buy 1 Take 1 treat — buy any Large Drink and get a Regular Pearl Milk Tea FREE. It’s the perfect way to share good fortune and sweet moments with loved ones.

item.title: A legacy fulfilled: Lisa Macuja Elizalde marks 40th homecoming celebration with a season of curated performances and a landmark collaboration with The Dawn
item.description: Exactly forty years ago, Lisa Macuja Elizalde made the defining choice to leave behind a flourishing career at the Kirov Ballet (now Mariinksy Ballet) in Moscow and return to the Philippines. That homecoming became the cornerstone of her mission to bring ballet to the people and people to ballet, a mission that has shaped generations of dancers and audiences.

item.title: Gong cha Chinese New Year Promo: 50% OFF Drinks
item.description: Gong cha is making Chinese New Year extra lucky! Enjoy 50% OFF on selected Medium drinks! Available at selected branches only, this festive promo is the perfect way to sip, save, and celebrate prosperity.

item.title: Pizza Hut 40% OFF Promo with BDO Credit Cards
item.description: Pizza lovers, get ready to indulge without breaking the bank! Enjoy a 40% OFF weekday treat at Pizza Hut when you pay with your BDO Credit Card. Whether you’re dining in with friends or grabbing take-out for the family, this exclusive deal makes every bite more satisfying.

item.title: The Metrobank Travel Fair 2026 at Glorietta
item.description: ​✈✈ The Metrobank Travel Fair Returns! The Metrobank Travel Fair 2026 is back at the Glorietta Activity Center from February 20–22, 2026! With exclusive deals from top airlines, cruises, hotels, and travel agencies, this event is your gateway to unforgettable adventures. Don’t miss your chance to book dreamy escapades and make 2026 your year of travel!
